blocks.text: Controversial Thai pageant personality Nawat Itsaragrisil surely knows how to pander to Filipino fans as another major titleholder from the Philippines is set to join the second season of his MGI All Stars competition — 2013 Miss World Megan Young. The American-Filipino actress and host, and the first Miss World winner from the Philippines, will join the country’s first-ever Miss Universe titleholder Gloria Diaz in the judging panel of the groundbreaking contest’s second season next month. MGI All Stars, a pageant among veterans of international beauty contests, announced Young’s inclusion as Season 2 judge on social media on Monday evening, Nov. […]...
